description.name: Entry
description.text: Seven single attacks (0.90 each) capped at 19999, grants [Attach Poison 3 with Stacking], [Damage Cap +10000], and [Zenith Mode], [Zenith Mode: Leila (Poison)] to the user

description.name: Zenith Mode: Leila (Poison)
description.text: Increases [Poison Infusion] damage bonus by 20%, cast speed x1.10 for PHY attacks, Poison abilities trigger 1 additional time, casts Spirit Attack: Leila (Poison) after using three Poison abilities (max 1), maximum HP +1500, grants [Astra] after taking the next action, removed if the character hasn't [Zenith Mode]

description.name: Pirate Anchor+

description.text: Grants [100% Critical 3] and [Deadly Strikes +20% 3] to the user

description.name: Attach Poison 3 with Stacking

description.name: Zenith Mode
description.text: Replaces certain Hero Abilities, certain Hero Abilities don't consume uses, after the duration the status only expires after the character takes an action
